author: Inside Edition
description: Body cam video has been released showing the moments after Tiger Woods' rollover accident. Deputies suspected Woods was under the influence and proceeded to give the golfing legend a field sobriety test. Then, he was put in handcuffs and informed he was under arrest. The deputies searched his pockets and said they found two pills, later identified as the painkiller hydrocodone. Inside Edition spoke with lawyer Dave Aronberg to analyze the bodycam footage.
title: Body Cam Footage Released of Tiger Woods' Arrest

description: Sofia and Daniel Mazariego from Utah planned on having a low-key elopement. But Mother Nature exposed them when a rockslide interrupted their moment. Because they used his classic car in their ceremony, Shane Schieve was there, and they got the incredible moment on video. Now that the video is popular, Sofia and Daniel Mazariego's wedding is no longer under wraps. Inside Edition Digital's Andrea Swindall has more. Wedding photography courtesy of @loisv.photography
title: Massive Rockslide Steals The Show During Utah Couple's 'Secret' Wedding
